note: Read by hand from the TI datasheet (SBVS050, Table 5-1 'Pin Functions', page 4), not by DS2SF: DBV (SOT-23-6) package, adjustable G01 version (VIT = 0.405 V).

pins.name: RESET
pins.description: Open-drain active-low reset; pull-up 10 k to 1 M; low while SENSE < VIT or MR low, then for the reset period.

pins.name: MR
pins.description: Manual reset, active low, internal 90 k pull-up to VDD.

pins.name: CT
pins.description: Reset period: open 20 ms; to VDD through 40-200 k 300 ms (pin table and section 7.3.2); or a capacitor to GND.

pins.name: SENSE
pins.description: Monitored voltage (via a divider for G01): RESET asserts below VIT = 0.405 V.

pins.name: VDD
pins.description: Supply 1.7-6.5 V; 0.1 uF ceramic close to the pin.
